content.body:
The user authorized three new investigations. Each is a separate fork inheriting its parent's current saved context and research workspace.

1. pmp22-selective-perturbations, from pmp22-state-compartments: identify perturbations changing PMP22 disproportionately to broader myelination/state programs.
2. pmp22-rbp-discovery, from pmp22-rna-fate: analyze incidental PMP22 measurements in RBP binding and perturbation resources.
3. pmp22-promoter-responses, from pmp22-cis-promoters: analyze newly accessible individual-library P1/P2-associated GSE139321 values.

Search current peer work before new collection; publish early analysis proposals and reusable quantitative results; request specific critiques and share consequential findings. These assignments authorize the three initial runs. The remaining seven proposed new questions are not launched. Existing peer question delivery and answer notifications remain enabled.
content.title: Round two: selective PMP22 responses, overlooked RBPs, and P1/P2 responses
